prompt:
Image editing task using 2 reference images

Reference-1: main subject
Reference-2: background

[Task 1: Subject Integrity — NO OUTFIT CHANGE]

Keep the subject EXACTLY as in the original image.

Rules (HARD LOCK):

Do NOT change clothing (no uniform conversion)
Do NOT modify outfit color, texture, or style
Keep original face, identity, expression, hairstyle, and proportions
Keep original pose and body structure
Remove only minor distracting accessories if necessary (optional, minimal)
[Task 2: Background Replacement]

Replace the background with the provided reference background.

Requirements:

Match perspective (camera angle, horizon, subject scale)
Match lighting direction and intensity
Adjust color tone (white balance, exposure) to blend naturally
Add realistic shadows under feet
Ensure proper ground contact (no floating)
[Composition Rules — HARD LOCK]:
Keep all original subjects (no extra / no missing people)
No face overlap or obstruction
Maintain natural spacing between subjects
Feet must touch ground naturally
No distortion of body or limbs
[Lighting & Realism]:
Follow background lighting source
Add soft, realistic shadows
Match contrast and dynamic range
Apply subtle ambient color reflection if needed
Avoid over-editing / HDR look
[Environment Integration]:
Do NOT retain original floor/ground
Seamless blending (no cutout edges, no halo)
Optional slight depth-of-field to match background
[Hard Constraints]:
No extra people
No missing subjects
No floating or unnatural positioning
No artifacts, glitches, or deformation
Clean, photorealistic output
[Final Goal]:

Natural, realistic photo with perfect subject-background integration,
while preserving original identity 100%.
